title: Iranian-rights committee public rally at Place Clairefontaine
reason: The report states that about 40 people attended this actual public rally, below the 50-person threshold.
notes: Although the group demanded Luxembourg support an EU resolution designating the IRGC and submitted a petition to the foreign minister, the reported simultaneous count is about 40. The sit-in at the Chamber is a separate action.

title: Iranian-rights committee sit-in tent near the Chamber of Deputies
reason: The report says three to six people were present at a time at the tent sit-in, below the 50-person threshold.
notes: Le Quotidien reports three to six people present at a time and rotating day/night. RTL on 14 February reports one individual still protesting outside the Chamber on day nine, with five days on hunger strike; it does not establish a group of 50 or more or prove that the earlier tent gathering continued unchanged throughout. Do not aggregate participants across dates or combine this sit-in with the separate 9 February rally.
